issues.detail: The instructions do not cover error handling or edge cases such as missing environment variables or exporter failures.
The skill assumes specific platforms (Node.js, Python, Docker) and a Grafana LGTM stack, limiting portability to other environments.

scenarios.name: node-express-instrumentation-with-custom-span
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the instrumentation setup, environment variables, and loading flag, but the custom span example deviates from the rubric; Response B lacks the required imports, OTLP exporters, and key details.

scenarios.name: python-service-opentelemetry-and-structured-logs
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers more of the rubric, including pip install, bootstrap, and instrumentation command, while Response B omits key items.

scenarios.name: collector-config-and-grafana-dashboard-with-alerts
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers the collector config and image usage but lacks dashboard and alerts; Response B fails to match exporter names and also lacks dashboard and alerts.
